patch_description: Extends the current multi-start greedy + local search framework with a 2-for-2 exchange neighborhood (two models from the hot GPU swapped with two models from another GPU), completing the neighborhood-richness ladder (move → 1-for-1 → 2-for-1 → 2-for-2). This escapes local optima where a single-model exchange cannot balance load/memory, while keeping runtime at ~0.00s.
